class.name: AnrFrameGeneration
class.brief_description: ANR FG (Apex Neural Rendering frame generation), driven natively by the engine.
class.description: The engine loads ANR FG's provider, [code]nvngx_dlssg.dll[/code], and drives it through its NGX Vulkan exports, as a game's NGX host would, with no OptiScaler, NVIDIA driver or Streamline. The provider's folder (the DLL with its [code]adapters[/code], [code]kernels[/code], [code]programs[/code] and [code]nr_fg.ini[/code]) is looked for in the [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_PATH[/code] environment variable, then [member ProjectSettings.rendering/anr_frame_generation/provider_path], then the [code]anr_fg[/code] folder next to the executable. Turn it on with [member Viewport.frame_generation] and [member Viewport.frame_generation_provider] set to [constant Viewport.FRAME_GENERATION_PROVIDER_ANR]. Each drawn frame is then preceded on screen by one generated frame. Environment variables: [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_FORCE=1[/code] turns it on for every viewport drawn to a window (tests), [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_PACING=0|1[/code] never holds the real frame back without V-Sync, or also does it in MAILBOX mode and when the GPU is behind (by default only in IMMEDIATE mode while the GPU keeps up: the wait is on the CPU, so ANR FG is meant to be used with V-Sync), [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_MATRICES=legacy|d3d[/code] passes the camera matrices as the first version did or with D3D's clip space Y up, [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_DYNAMIC_RES=0[/code] makes the provider's feature again at every render size change instead of once for any size up to the output size, [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_OUTPUT_REAL=1[/code] also passes the provider a real-frame output it copies the backbuffer into, [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_MVEC_SCALE=normalized[/code] gives the motion vector scale as 1 instead of the render size, [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_DEBUG=generated[/code] shows the generated frame in place of the real one (a viewport capture then saves it), [code]GODOT_ANR_FG_EXIT=full|release|none[/code] chooses what is torn down at exit.

method.name: get_evaluated_frames
method.description: Frames the provider generated successfully (NGX EvaluateFeature calls that succeeded).

method.name: get_last_result
method.description: The last NGX result code ([code]1[/code] is success, [code]0xBAD0xxxx[/code] a failure).

method.name: get_max_generated_frames
method.description: The provider's [code]DLSSG.MultiFrameCountMax[/code]: generated frames it can make per drawn frame. The engine generates one.

method.name: get_presented_frames
method.description: Generated frames presented to a window.

method.name: get_provider_path
method.description: The provider DLL's path, found or looked for.

method.name: get_provider_version
method.description: The provider DLL's file version, once loaded.

method.name: get_status
method.description: What ANR FG is doing ([code]ready[/code], [code]running[/code]), or why it is unavailable. [code]inactive: [/code] when frame generation is on but no frame is generated, for example when the window's swap chain cannot present a second image.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Loads the provider and initializes NGX on the rendering device on first call. [code]true[/code] when frames can be generated.
